slots.dense-layered-architecture/title: A governed integration layer can connect the journey without forcing consolidation
slots.dense-layered-architecture/kicker/text: Avoid an additional ungoverned copy of case state.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience-wh: Experience layer covers the requester portal, agent workspace, and supervisor decisions.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services-why/: Orchestration layer covers case state and rules, exception routing, and integration events.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation-wh: The governance band defines product ownership, data stewardship, and change gates.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/governance-ba: Platform layer covers identity and access, case data and audit, telemetry, and support.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/security-band: The security band spans identity, least privilege, data retention, and monitoring.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience/in: A canonical identifier and published event contracts connect the journey without requiring one platform in the first release.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience/wo: Interface feasibility, data authority, retention rules, and control design require client review.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience/co: Keep transaction ownership in existing processing systems until an explicit migration decision.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services/orch: Coordinate handoffs and exception paths with explicit service ownership and recovery steps.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services/rule: Existing systems remain transaction owners; the diagram does not imply consolidation.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services/inte: These are proposed responsibilities, not a prescribed vendor product stack.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation/in: Define trusted records, lineage and access boundaries; validate quality at critical handoffs.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation/en: Automate deployment checks and release evidence; make changes reproducible and reversible.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation/op: Monitor workflow health and service reliability; connect alerts to accountable responders.
slots.slide/takeaway: Layered responsibilities connect the journey while transaction ownership stays in existing systems.
